original_question:
Design a Verilog module that implements a single-bit full adder with a standard sum output and an inverted carry-out output.

The module must be named `sky130_fd_sc_ls__fahcon`.

It should have the following ports with the specified names and directions:
Output `COUT_N` (representing the inverted carry-out)
Output `SUM` (representing the standard sum)
Input `A`
Input `B`
Input `CI`

Implement the logic such that the `SUM` output is the standard sum of the three inputs (`A`, `B`, and `CI`), and the `COUT_N` output is the logical inverse of the standard carry-out generated by the three inputs.
